arxiv-2012-15578.title: Deficiency indices and discreteness property of block Jacobi matrices and Dirac operators with point interactions
arxiv-2012-15578.creator: Viktoriya S. Budyka, Mark M. Malamud
arxiv-2012-15578.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Viktoriya S. Budyka, Mark M. Malamud. The paper concerns with infinite symmetric block Jacobi matrices 𝐉 \bf J with p × p p\times p -matrix entries. We present new conditions for general block Jacobi matrices to be selfadjoint and have discrete spectrum.

arxiv-2102-03795.title: Unsupervised Sentence-embeddings by Manifold Approximation and Projection
arxiv-2102-03795.creator: Subhradeep Kayal
arxiv-2102-03795.description: Abstract The concept of unsupervised universal sentence encoders has gained traction recently, wherein pre-trained models generate effective task-agnostic fixed-dimensional representations for phrases, sentences and paragraphs. Such methods are of varying complexity, from simple weighted-averages of word vectors to complex language-models based on bidirectional transformers.

arxiv-2111-14980.title: Statistical Hauser-Feshbach model description of ( n , α ) (n,\alpha) reaction cross sections for the weak s-process
arxiv-2111-14980.creator: Sema Küçüksucu, Mustafa Yiğit, Nils Paar
arxiv-2111-14980.description: Abstract The ( n , α ) (n,\alpha) reaction contributes in many processes of energy generation and nucleosynthesis in stellar environment. Since experimental data are available for a limited number of nuclei and in restricted energy ranges, at present only theoretical studies can provide predictions for all astrophysically relevant ( n , α ) (n,\alpha) reaction cross sections.

arxiv-2205-00475.title: Formal Languages via Theories over Strings
arxiv-2205-00475.creator: Joel Day, Vijay Ganesh, Nathan Grewal, Florin Manea
arxiv-2205-00475.description: Abstract We investigate the properties of formal languages expressible in terms of formulas over quantifier-free theories of word equations, arithmetic over length constraints, and language membership predicates for the classes of regular, visibly pushdown, and deterministic context-free languages. In total, we consider 20 distinct theories and decidability questions for problems such as emptiness and universality for formal languages over them.

arxiv-2305-17351.creator: Jinpeng Zhang, Nini Xiao, Ke Wang, Chuanqi Dong, Xiangyu Duan, Yuqi Zhang, Min Zhang, Institute of Aritificial Intelligence, School of Computer Science, TechnologySoochow University, Alibaba DAMO Academyjpzhang1@stu.suda.edu.cn; xiangyuduan@suda.edu.cn
arxiv-2305-17351.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Jinpeng Zhang, Nini Xiao, Ke Wang, Chuanqi Dong, Xiangyu Duan, Yuqi Zhang, Min Zhang, Institute of Aritificial Intelligence, School of Computer Science, TechnologySoochow University, Alibaba DAMO Academyjpzhang1@stu.suda.edu.cn; xiangyuduan@suda.edu.cn. Lexically constrained neural machine translation (LCNMT), which controls the translation generation with pre-specified constraints, is important in many practical applications. Current approaches to LCNMT typically assume that the pre-specified lexical constraints are contextually appropriate.

arxiv-2310-14385.title: Minimum Decomposition on Maxmin Trees
arxiv-2310-14385.creator: Emmy Huang and Ray Tang
arxiv-2310-14385.description: Abstract . Maxmin trees are trees that consist of nodes that are either local minimums or maximums. Such trees were first studied by Postnikov. Later Dugan, Glennon, Gunnells, and Steingrimsson introduced the concept of weight to these trees and proved a bijection between maximum weight maxmin trees and permutations, defining weights for permutations.

arxiv-2504-07928.title: Riemann zeros and the KKR determinant
arxiv-2504-07928.creator: Zongrui Pei
arxiv-2504-07928.description: Abstract We transform the counting function for the Riemann zeros into a Korringa–Kohn–Rostoker (KKR) determinant, assisted by Krein’s theorem. This is based on our observation that the function derived from a few methods can all be recast into two terms: one corresponds to the scattering phase, and the other is similar to structure constants related to the Green function.

arxiv-2602-23765.title: DashengTokenizer: One layer is enough for unified audio understanding and generation
arxiv-2602-23765.creator: Heinrich Dinkel, Xingwei Sun, Gang Li, Jiahao Mei, Yadong Niu, Xiyang Li, Yifan Liao, Jiahao Zhou, Junbo Zhang, Jian Luan
arxiv-2602-23765.description: Abstract This paper introduces DashengTokenizer, a continuous audio tokenizer engineered for joint use in both understanding and generation tasks. Unlike conventional approaches, which train acoustic tokenizers and subsequently integrate frozen semantic knowledge, our method inverts this paradigm: we leverage frozen semantic features and inject acoustic information.

pmc-10571790.title: Genome-Wide Association Study Identifies Novel Candidate Variants Associated with Postoperative Nausea and Vomiting
pmc-10571790.creator: Daisuke Nishizawa, Ryozo Morino, Rie Inoue, Seii Ohka, Shinya Kasai, Junko Hasegawa, Yuko Ebata, Kyoko Nakayama, Hiroyuki Sumikura, Masakazu Hayashida, Miyuki Yokota, Kazutaka Ikeda, Dario Bugada, Juan P Cata
pmc-10571790.description: Simple SummaryPostoperative nausea and vomiting (PONV) is experienced by approximately 30% of patients who undergo general anesthesia. However, many genetic factors involved in the vulnerability to PONV remain unidentified. The aim of our genome-wide association study (GWAS) was to comprehensively explore genetic variations associated with PONV.

pmc-11292700.title: Lipomatous pseudohypertrophy of the pancreas mimicking liposarcoma: A case report
pmc-11292700.creator: Tomomi Kamimura, Takashi Katsube, Takeshi Nishi, Yasunari Kawabata, Yoshitsugu Tajima, Asuka Araki, Yasushi Kaji
pmc-11292700.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Lipomatous pseudohypertrophy of the pancreas (LPH) is a rare disease in which the pancreatic parenchyma is replaced with mature adipose tissue. It is an idiopathic condition whose diagnosis is made based on histopathological analyses. Herein, we report the case of a 50-year-old male patient with a lipomatous mass in the head of the pancreas on computed tomography for close examination of a renal tumor. We suspected liposarcoma, and laparotomy was performed. However, histological analyses revealed LPH.

pmc-11610720.title: Reframing Child Protection in Emergency Medicine
pmc-11610720.creator: Joseph P Shapiro, Genevieve Preer, Caroline J Kistin
pmc-11610720.description: Child maltreatment remains a concerning source of morbidity and mortality in the United States, where more than 600,000 children are victims of abuse each year, with well-described, long-term consequences for physical and mental health.However, the US child welfare system is characterized by systemic racism and inequity.

pmc-11639655.title: Improving Survey Inference Using Administrative Records Without Releasing Individual‐Level Continuous Data
pmc-11639655.creator: Sharifa Z. Williams, Jungang Zou, Yutao Liu, Yajuan Si, Sandro Galea, Qixuan Chen
pmc-11639655.description: Probability surveys are challenged by increasing nonresponse rates, resulting in biased statistical inference. Auxiliary information about populations can be used to reduce bias in estimation. Often continuous auxiliary variables in administrative records are first discretized before releasing to the public to avoid confidentiality breaches.

pmc-11709956.creator: Sarah Tomaszewski Farias
pmc-11709956.description: BackgroundThe purpose of this study was to evaluate a variety of intrapersonal factors that may also be associated with everyday functional outcomes in older adults with subjective cognitive decline (SCD).Participants and MethodsParticipants included 127 older adults with SCD (age M = 73.1, SD = 4.9; education M = 15.4, SD = 2.

pmc-12394672.title: Research on optimal deep learning modeling in HaiNan dialect recognition
pmc-12394672.creator: ZiXuan Qi, FuYun Li, HaiXia Long
pmc-12394672.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The speech recognition task of the HaiNan dialect faces significant differences in phonology, intonation, and grammatical structure among dialects, which in turn show significant regionalization characteristics, which makes the task of dialect-to-Mandarin conversion more complex. Currently, the research on the HaiNan dialect speech recognition is still in its early stages and lacks sufficient corpus resources, especially in the task of multi-dialect recognition. Traditional models are difficult to solve with the problem of data scarcity and diverse dialect characteristics effectively.

pmc-12533255.title: Th1 and Th2 cells in equine endometrosis and their interactions with endometrial fibroblasts
pmc-12533255.creator: Anna Wójtowicz, Agnieszka Sadowska, Tomasz Molcan, Magda Słyszewska, Ewa Monika Drzewiecka, Dawid Tobolski, Graça Ferreira-Dias, Anna Szóstek-Mioduchowska
pmc-12533255.description: Mare endometrosis is a chronic degenerative condition of the endometrium, primarily characterized by fibrosis, involving interactions among fibroblasts, immune cells, and epithelial cells regulated by cytokines and growth factors. T helper (Th)1 and Th2 cells seem to play a pivotal role in fibrosis. However, their roles in equine endometrial fibrosis remain unknown.

pmc-12583511.title: Machine learning analysis and simulation of pharmaceutical drying process based on prediction of concentration distribution and mass transfer
pmc-12583511.creator: Khaled Almansour, Hashem O Alsaab
pmc-12583511.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Modeling and analysis of the lyophilization process for low-temperature drying of pharmaceutical compounds was evaluated via a hybrid model that combines mass transfer and machine learning. We investigated the predictive accuracy of three machine learning models— Ridge Regression (RR), Support Vector Regression (SVR), and Decision Tree (DT)—for estimating the concentration (C) in a three-dimensional space, characterized by coordinates X, Y, and Z. Hyper-parameter optimization was performed using the Dragonfly Algorithm (DA) to enhance model performance.

pmc-12628719.title: Novel Thyroid Hormone Receptor β Gene Variant (F245L) Causing Mild Resistance to Thyroid Hormone
pmc-12628719.creator: Keiko Yamagami, Naotetsu Kanamoto, Yui Yamashita, Yumiko Sasai, Tetsuya Tagami
pmc-12628719.description: A novel thyroid hormone receptor β (THRB) variant was identified in a 34-year-old Japanese man with resistance to thyroid hormone β (RTHβ). He presented with mildly elevated serum thyroid hormone and nonsuppressed TSH levels in the absence of a goiter. Genetic testing revealed a novel heterozygous missense variant of THRB (c.733T > C; p.F245L).

pmc-12799495.title: Circulating tumour DNA (ctDNA) as a predictor of progression-free and overall survival in non-resectable pancreatic cancer: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12799495.creator: Mette M. Steiniche, Louise B. Callesen, Elizabeth H. Vlk, Lise Ventzel, Signe Timm, Rikke F. Andersen, Sidsel C. Lindgaard, Torben F. Hansen, Morten Ladekarl, Karen-Lise G. Spindler
pmc-12799495.description: BackgroundThis systematic review and meta-analysis synthesised current evidence on circulating tumour DNA (ctDNA) for predicting clinical outcomes in patients with non-resectable pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC).MethodsPubMed, Embase, and Cochrane databases were searched up to 31/01/2025. Eligible studies reported prognostic value of ctDNA in patients with non-resectable PDAC.

pmc-12859308.title: Effect of salt solution wash versus warm water wash for leucorrhea symptoms among postmenopausal women
pmc-12859308.creator: Siva Subramanian N, Sonalben Sendhabhai Nadiya, Sandipkumar Rajeshbhai Patel, Gnanadesigan Ekambaram, Venkateshwaran T, Anuradha M, Dhana Priya G, Rama lakshmi G, Mahalakshmi B
pmc-12859308.description: Leucorrhea is a common gynecological concern among postmenopausal women, often resulting from infections, hormonal changes, or hygiene issues. Therefore, it is of interest to compare the effectiveness of salt solution wash versus warm water wash in reducing leucorrhea symptoms. Hence, sixty postmenopausal women were divided equally into two groups for a 7-day intervention.

pmc-13093875.title: Tailoring exciplex formation in metal-induced supramolecular organization
pmc-13093875.creator: Giau Le-Hoang, Laure Guénée, Claude Piguet
pmc-13093875.description: The intramolecular π-polarization induced upon binding the bichromophoric ligand L1 to lanthanide ions produces intermolecular hetero-π-stacked pyrene–terimine organization in the resulting complexes as ascertained by ground state supramolecular aggregations leading to dimeric [L1Ln(hfac)3]2 (Ln = Y, Eu) units both in the solid state (X-ray crystal structure determination) and in dichloromethane solution (1H NMR titrations).

pmc-13185039.title: Pharmacokinetics, dosing exposure and safety of oral ibuprofen in Chinese preterm neonates with patent ductus arteriosus: preliminary report
pmc-13185039.creator: Dan Xiao, Yiyuan Sun, Yongji He, Chaoqun He, Ying Jin, Lisha Fu, Rui Sun, Bo Wang, Zhenlei Wang
pmc-13185039.description: ObjectiveThe use of oral ibuprofen to treat haemodynamically significant patent ductus arteriosus (hsPDA) in premature neonates is common. However, among Chinese preterm neonates, the available pharmacokinetic (PK) findings for its enantiomers remain merely descriptive. This study aimed to characterise the PKs, dosing exposure and safety of oral ibuprofen in Chinese preterm infants treated with hsPDA.DesignA pilot trial.

pmc-13301617.title: Skeletal Age Evaluation with BAUSportTM Ultrasound in Young Slovak Female Athletes and Non-Athletes—A Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-13301617.creator: Petra Švábová (nee Uhrová), Iveta Cihová, Michal Soták, Darina Falbová, Lenka Vorobeľová, Radoslav Beňuš, Lucia Bundová
pmc-13301617.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background: Biological maturity assessment is increasingly discussed in youth sport because chronological age alone does not reflect inter-individual variation in growth and pubertal timing. Ultrasound-based systems such as BAUSport™ provide a radiation-free alternative to radiographic skeletal age assessment. This exploratory cross-sectional study examined skeletal age (SA) in Slovak female volleyball players, track-and-field athletes, and non-athletes using BAUSport™, while acknowledging substantial age differences between groups.

pmc-13354534.title: Resolution of lone atrial fibrillation in a patient with severe pectus excavatum after Nuss procedure: a case report
pmc-13354534.creator: Raissa Li, Sara L Lee, Paul Harnish, Farokh R Demehri
pmc-13354534.description: Pectus excavatum (PE) is the most common congenital chest wall deformity but its association with atrial fibrillation (AF) remains underrecognized. We present a case where surgical correction of PE resulted in complete resolution of AF, highlighting the role of structural compression in lone AF and other arrhythmias.

pmc-13673871.title: A smart vision assistance system designed for the cybathlon 2024 vision assistance race to support individuals with visual impairments
pmc-13673871.creator: Simon Senoner, Simon Winkler, Lukas Neururer, Leon Ochtendung, Julia Jackermaier, Marcel Naderer, Bernhard Tschulnigg, Bernhard Hollaus, Yeongmi Kim
pmc-13673871.description: Individuals with visual impairments continue to face challenges in performing everyday tasks, despite ongoing advances in assistive technologies.
